function.name: api_readIssues
function.description: List Assurance issues within an optional time window. Keep the filters unchanged when requesting subsequent pages.

startTime.description: Inclusive start time in UTC epoch milliseconds.

endTime.description: Inclusive end time in UTC epoch milliseconds.

limit.description: Page size. The controller defaults to 10 when omitted.

offset.description: One-based position of the first record. The controller defaults to 1.

status.description: Optional filter for one issue status.
